purpose: Fail the docs build if any feature gated behind LicenseFeature.TrikdisFunctions is documented. Those features are Trikdis-internal and must not appear in customer-facing manuals.
authority: Aleksejus Tkačiovas, ATPR3I05-516 comment 2026-08-13: 'Negalima rašyti apie funkcijas, kurios aktyvuojamos turint LicenseFeature.TrikdisFunctions. Tai yra mums skirtos funkcijos.'

source.recheck_note: Re-derive this list whenever ipcc_web changes. Grep the source for 'TrikdisFunctions', then trace each consumer (trikdisFunctionsEnabled / trikdisFeaturesEnabled) into its template.

exclude_rationale.docs/en/receivers/ipcom/ui/ha-cluster-ba: Unpublished draft, held out of the build via exclude_docs in mkdocs.yml. The guard also asserts that exclusion is still in place.

matching.accent_folding_note: Terms and content are both NFD-normalized with combining marks stripped, so an 'cluster' term matches Spanish 'clúster'. The 2026-09-03 audit initially missed es/general.md line 100 for exactly this reason.

cross_language_note: The manuals keep IPCom UI control names in English even in LT/ES/RU pages (observed: 'Enable cluster', 'Enabled', 'Port', 'Whitelist', 'Encrypt' all untranslated). English control-name terms are therefore effective across every language tree, and translated forms are added below as they are observed.

gated_features.ui_label: Track device sessions / session data point retention
controls: Number of session data points to keep

gated_features.ui_label: Objects table: session_avg_time column and filter
Objects context menu: Communication log / Session log / Console
gated_features.narrowing: Bare 'console' is deliberately NOT a term — it false-positives on ordinary prose. A page documenting the menu item as just 'Console' would slip past this guard; that is a known, accepted gap, not an oversight.

allow.line_contains: System logs and session logs for operational visibility
allow.reason: Generic prose about IPCom's logging capability in the product overview, not the licence-gated per-object 'Session log...' context-menu action. Reviewed 2026-09-03.

gated_features.ui_label: Logs: right-click context menu -> Log settings popup
controls: Log settings popup (internal users, or 'administrator' with the licence)

not_gated_but_related.note: Listed unconditionally in users.component.ts:39; only filtered when settings are absent, NOT by the licence flag. Not treated as gated here, but it is the permission for a gated feature — raise with Alex if it ever gets documented.
